text: Before entry, the loader shall validate selected module/object/contract identities, segment byte digests/region bounds, catalog references/entries/signatures, and regenerated topological order, then install already linked segments and transfer in the required CPU/native-stack state to bootstrap. Failed checks shall prevent execution rather than become catchable runtime faults.
